          FRONTEND_READY=false
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do

              echo "Frontend is ready"
              FRONTEND_READY=true

      - name: Smoke test backend login

      # Persist Playwright's last-run metadata across workflow runs so a push

      #
      # To only re-run previously failing tests, either:
      #  - trigger the workflow manually with only_last_failed=true, or
      #  - include "[e2e-only-failed]" in the HEAD commit message.
      - name: Determine test mode
        id: test_mode
        run: |
          HEAD_MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B)
          if [[ "$HEAD_MSG" == *"[e2e-only-failed]"* ]] || [[ "${{ inputs.only_last_failed }}" == "true" ]]; then

            echo "only_last_failed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Restore last-run metadata
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v6
        with:
          path: Clients/test-results/.last-run.json
          key: playwright-last-run-${{ github.ref }}-shard${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

            playwright-last-run-${{ github.ref }}-shard${{ matrix.shard }}-

        working-directory: Clients
        env:
          E2E_BASE_URL: http://localhost:5173
          E2E_EMAIL: admin@verifywise-test.com
          E2E_PASSWORD: TestAdmin!Str0ng
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
        run: |
          if [ -f test-results/.last-run.json ]; then
            FAILED_COUNT=$(jq '.failedTestIds | length' test-results/.last-run.json)
            if [ "$FAILED_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "Re-running $FAILED_COUNT previously failed test(s)"
              npx playwright test --last-failed
            else
              echo "No previously failed tests; skipping last-failed step."
            fi
          else
            echo "No previous run metadata found; skipping last-failed step."
          fi

        if: ${{ steps.test_mode.outputs.only_last_failed != 'true' }}
        working-directory: Clients
        env:
          E2E_BASE_URL: http://localhost:5173

          # global.setup logs in as a non-super-admin and the flow cannot create
          # organizations. seedE2EAdmin (spawned by global.setup) also needs the

          E2E_EMAIL: admin@verifywise-test.com
          E2E_PASSWORD: TestAdmin!Str0ng
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres

      - name: Save last-run metadata
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@v6
        with:
          path: Clients/test-results/.last-run.json
          key: playwright-last-run-${{ github.ref }}-shard${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: playwright-report-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: Clients/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 14

      # scan runs. It records the rules that were disabled, and why, alongside
      # the results — a report claiming zero violations is only meaningful next
      # to the list of what was not checked. Written directly by the helper
      # rather than by a reporter, so it exists whatever the reporter config is.
      - name: Upload accessibility report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: accessibility-report-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: Clients/accessibility-report/
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: playwright-results-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: Clients/test-results/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload backend logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: backend-logs-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: |
            /tmp/backend.log
            /tmp/worker.log
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload AIGateway logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: aigateway-logs-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: /tmp/aigateway.log
          retention-days: 7
